profile.geoLocationName: Fort Lee, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Secaucus, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Led a project to provide users to visualize statuses on HDD’s based on the station/fixture as well as allow users to update the cards with the appropriate firmware packages, and printing labels once they have been updated
• Designed and deployed a configuration application by working closely with factory workers to allow users to perform CRUD operations in order to edit firmware packages and stations in NEXT.js using app router and SSR
• Implemented a real‑time Watchlist feature for the dashboard application to provide a more personalized user experience
• Created and optimized mongoDB aggregation queries with performance increases of up to 500% utilizing fewer lookups and indexing optimizations
• Utilized graphQL on the dashboard application including subscriptions and CRUD operations using Python’s fastAPI on chichen Itza
• Developed proficiency to be familiar with full stack development, implementing applications and features from the back‑end to the front‑end including database modifications whenever necessary

positions.locationName: Mount Arlington, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer & Packet Administrator
positions.description:
• Defined project scope, communicated with specialists, and wrote specifications for several modules such as Transaction Entry, RF Barcode, and Enhanced Laser Printing to provide new tasks for developers
• Managed the flow of packets from initial submission, specialist review, quality assurance assignment to final approval so that enhancements are installed on client accounts in a timely manner
• Connected to live client accounts to install/debug programs, files for any changes in data structures, and utilities to simplify repetitive, manual processes
• Reviewed packets that needed to be merged and determined if any clashes existed by comparing packets that contained the same program in order to continue flow of packets

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Submitted pull requests through JIRA to enhance UX/UI for the kiosk on mobile/tablet using React.JS in order to expand the range of devices
able to access the kiosk
• Revamped popular processes used by clients such as Sales Order Entry, Returns, Exchanges, and Transfers for a cleaner and more intuitive
experience
• Worked closely with a UX/UI team to streamline the front end of dynamic tab screens using XAML so that the user experience is linear
• Mentored interns to guide and familiarize them with STORIS standards, procedures, and infrastructure
• Investigated and resolved cases requested by clients in a timely manner to remedy any bugs or outstanding issues

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Modified existing programs within the STORIS application to decrease the average time spent of looping through records in a file from 𝑂(𝑛^2) to 𝑂(𝑛)
• Ameliorated several inhouse processes such as billing and task entry/inquiry to shorten the billing processing time for employees
• Performed quality assurance on projects submitted by developers to minimize the amount of bugs or potential issues before it is final approved

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed and proposed a web application template to expedite and streamline checkout process 
on Urgent Care website using ASP.NET (C#)
• Received instruction and training from engineering team in medical SQL databases to query 
patients and determine room assignment
• Updated SQL tables and records of products and customers to maintain scalability
